title: claytonia sibirica var. heterophylla
intro: Claytonia sibirica var. heterophylla, commonly known as Siberian miner's lettuce, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Portulacaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, digestive issues, and skin problems, due to its multiple health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and vitamins, particularly vitamin C, which provide its medicinal properties.
